units.title: 初一阅读：新书封面的晾干位置

materials.title: Book Cover Drying
materials.text:
Our class is making paper covers for the reading-room books. On Monday, the teacher brings ten sheets of blue paper and a small bottle of glue. We work in pairs. Each pair makes one cover, but we do not put the wet covers on the books yet.

There are two tables by the windows. The table on the left is for wet covers. The table on the right is for finished covers that are dry. Sam puts his cover on the right because he likes the view from that window. His partner touches the edge and says, “It is still wet.” They move it to the left table.

At the end of the lesson, we write our names on small cards, not on the covers. Each card goes beside a cover so the teacher knows whose work it is. The books stay on the shelf until Wednesday. On that day, we will choose a dry cover for each book and check that it opens easily.

questions.prompt: What does each pair make?
questions.explanation: B正确：each pair one cover；C十张是纸非书；A窗不是作品。

questions.prompt: Where should a wet cover go?
questions.explanation: C正确：左桌晾湿封面；A右桌放已干；B明确不立即套书。

questions.prompt: Why does Sam first choose the right table?
questions.explanation: C正确：likes view；B未说胶价；A名卡后来才写。

questions.prompt: Where are the students’ names written?
questions.explanation: B正确：写小卡不写封面；C窗、A书页均不合。

questions.prompt: When will the covers be put on books?
questions.explanation: C正确：books until Wednesday再选干封面；A周一制作；B湿时不套。

units.title: 初一阅读：水族箱旁的喂食卡

materials.title: Aquarium Turn Card
materials.text:
There is a small fish tank in our classroom. Two students help with it each day. This week, the teacher puts a turn card beside the tank. One student reads the card, and the other checks the food box with the teacher.

On Tuesday, Mei comes early. She wants to feed the fish, but the card already says “Done” beside Tuesday's date. Mei asks the teacher before opening the food box. The teacher says that Jack has already helped that morning. Mei closes the box and does not add any more food.

There is still a job for her. A picture card has fallen behind the tank. Mei cannot reach it safely from the floor, so she asks the teacher to move it. Then Mei writes the names of Tuesday's helpers on the turn card. On Wednesday, it will be her turn to read the new card before any food is used.

questions.prompt: Where is the turn card?
questions.explanation: A正确：card beside tank；B盒内、C门后无据。

questions.prompt: What does Tuesday’s card say when Mei arrives?
questions.explanation: C正确：日期旁Done；A永久关闭、B无鱼均未写。

questions.prompt: Who has already helped that morning?
questions.explanation: A正确：老师说Jack已帮；C弟、B外校访客无此信息。

questions.prompt: What does Mei do about the extra food?
options: Puts it all in the tank.
questions.explanation: B正确：不再加食；A相反；C不是人午餐。

questions.prompt: What will Mei do first on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: A正确：轮到她先读新卡；C未让独自挪缸；B非藏卡。

units.title: 初一阅读：雨天的临时接车点

materials.title: Rainy Bus Shelter
materials.text:
School minibus notice for Friday

The usual meeting place by the sports hall is closed while workers mend the roof. The minibus will wait beside the east gate instead. Please walk there on the path past the library. Do not use the short path through the work area.

The bus leaves at four fifteen. Mr Dean will be at the east gate from four o'clock to help students. If it rains, students may wait under the library's covered entrance until he calls them. They should stay where he can see them.

The large blue bags for the swimming team will go into the back of the bus first. Students should keep small schoolbags with them. Anyone who does not need the minibus must tell Mr Dean before lunch, so he does not wait for them at the gate.

This change is for Friday only. On Monday, students should check the new notice before deciding where to wait.

questions.prompt: Why is the usual meeting place closed?
questions.explanation: B正确：工人修屋顶；A图书馆没搬；C车仍运行。

questions.prompt: Where will the minibus wait?
questions.explanation: C正确：east gate；B馆内非车点；A工作区不可穿行。

questions.prompt: Where may students wait if it rains?
options: In the back of the bus alone.
questions.explanation: C正确：图书馆有顶门厅；A未让独自上车；B非工地后。

questions.prompt: Which bags go into the bus first?
questions.explanation: B正确：游泳队大蓝包先装；A小包随身；C未说午餐包。

questions.prompt: What should a student who does not need the bus do?
options: Wait silently at the east gate.
questions.explanation: A正确：不用车须午餐前告知；C会误等；B周一需读新告示。

units.title: 初一阅读：午餐托盘上的姓名卡

materials.title: Lunch Tray Delivery
materials.text:
Today, Class Seven is having lunch in the classroom because the dining room floor is being cleaned. The kitchen sends three trays with different coloured cards. The yellow card says “Rice for Eva”. The green card says “Soup for Luis”. The white card says “Sandwich for Kim”.

Eva and Kim are in the classroom, but Luis is helping in the library. A classroom helper puts the soup on the teacher's desk and covers it. She does not give it to another student. The teacher will call Luis when he can return.

Kim opens his tray and finds a spoon beside the sandwich. Eva has a fork beside her rice. They smile at the mistake but do not swap food. The helper asks the kitchen for a clean fork for Kim and takes the unused spoon back.

After lunch, students put their empty trays on the trolley outside the door. They keep the name cards on the classroom table so the teacher can check the delivery list.

questions.prompt: Why is lunch in the classroom today?
options: The dining room floor is being cleaned.
questions.explanation: A正确：餐厅地面清洁；C馆有书无关；B厨房仍送饭。

questions.prompt: Who is the soup for?
questions.explanation: C正确：绿卡Soup for Luis；A Eva米饭；B Kim三明治。

questions.prompt: Where is Luis’s tray kept while he is away?
questions.explanation: A正确：教师桌盖着；B馆地、C书包均未送。

questions.prompt: What does the helper get for Kim?
questions.explanation: A正确：向厨房要干净叉；C未加三明治；B不交换食物。

questions.prompt: What stays on the classroom table after lunch?
questions.explanation: B正确：姓名卡留桌核清单；A盘去门外车；C车门外。

units.title: 初一阅读：游泳馆更衣柜的号码

materials.title: Pool Locker Number
materials.text:
Leah goes to a swimming lesson with her class. At the entrance, the coach gives each student a small wrist band with a locker number. Leah's band says 24. She puts her clothes in locker 24 and closes the door.

After the lesson, Leah sees a blue band on the floor. Its number is 42. She does not try it on her locker. Instead, she takes it to the coach. The coach checks the class list and finds that it belongs to Dan, who is still drying his hair.

Leah then looks for her own band. It is under the towel on her chair. She puts it on her wrist before returning to locker 24. Her shoes are on the bottom shelf and her jacket is hanging inside the door.

Before leaving, Leah returns the band to the desk by the exit. The coach asks everyone to look inside their lockers one last time. A cleaner will check the room after the class has gone.

questions.prompt: Which locker does Leah use?
questions.explanation: B正确：她号码24；A捡到Dan42；C14无据。

questions.prompt: What does Leah do with the band found on the floor?
questions.explanation: B正确：交教练；C不尝她柜，A不带走。

questions.prompt: Who owns band 42?
questions.explanation: A正确：列表查得Dan；C老师、B清洁员非主人。

questions.prompt: Where does Leah find her own band?
questions.explanation: B正确：自己椅子毛巾下；A鞋内、C水里无据。

questions.prompt: Where is the band returned before Leah leaves?
options: To the desk by the exit.
To the bottom shelf with her shoes.
questions.explanation: B正确：出口桌归还；A他人柜、C鞋架不合。

units.title: 初一阅读：乐器盒里的回收单

materials.title: Music Case Return
materials.text:
The music teacher is collecting the small instruments used in this week's class. There are wooden boxes for shakers and long cloth bags for recorders. The large drum stays beside the piano, where the teacher will check it later.

Owen has two shakers in his bag. One has a loose handle. He puts that one on the red repair tray instead of hiding it in a wooden box. The other shaker goes back in its usual box. Owen writes a short note about the loose handle and leaves it beside the tray.

Lily cannot find her recorder bag. The teacher gives her a spare bag from the cupboard. She asks Lily to write “spare” on a small card and put it inside, so the next class knows where it came from.

At the end, two students carry the wooden boxes to the store room. Owen takes the repair tray to the teacher's desk. The drum has not moved, and nobody should carry it until the teacher has finished checking it.

questions.prompt: Where should working shakers go?
options: Beside the drum on the floor.
questions.explanation: A正确：shakers木盒；B布袋给竖笛；C地板无此安排。

questions.prompt: Where does Owen put the shaker with a loose handle?
questions.explanation: A正确：松柄入红维修盘；C给竖笛袋不合；B没藏琴下。

questions.prompt: What does Owen leave with the repair tray?
questions.explanation: B正确：写松柄小注；A演出票、C新鼓无据。

questions.prompt: Why does Lily put a card in the spare bag?
options: To hide her recorder from the next class.
To ask Owen to carry the drum.
To show that the bag came from the cupboard as a spare.
questions.explanation: C正确：标spare使下班知来源；A非藏乐器；B卡不安排搬鼓。

questions.prompt: Who should check the large drum before anyone moves it?
questions.explanation: C正确：老师完成检查才搬；A Lily、B下班均未负责。

units.title: 初一阅读：周末摊位的取货办法

materials.title: Market Order Pickup
materials.text:
Mum asks Ravi to collect a small cake from the Saturday market. She gives him an order card with the name “Ravi Patel” and a picture of a lemon. The cake is already paid for. Ravi does not need to bring money for it.

There are two cake stalls. One has a red roof and sells bread as well as cakes. The other has a green roof and only sells cakes. The order card says “Green Roof Cakes”, so Ravi joins the line there.

A woman at the stall asks for the card. She checks the name before giving Ravi a white box. Ravi looks at the label and sees a strawberry picture. He politely shows the woman the lemon on his order card. She thanks him and changes the box.

Ravi puts the cake flat in the basket of his bicycle. He walks the bicycle through the busy market instead of riding between people. At the gate, he meets Mum, and they check the box together before going home.

questions.prompt: What kind of cake is on the order card?
questions.explanation: B正确：卡柠檬图；C初错盒草莓；A巧克力无据。

questions.prompt: Why does Ravi not need to pay at the stall?
options: The cake is already paid for.
questions.explanation: C正确：已付款；B并非全免费；A他有卡。

questions.prompt: Which stall should Ravi use?
questions.explanation: A正确：卡Green Roof Cakes；C红顶另一家；B不是仅面包铺。

questions.prompt: What does Ravi do when he sees the wrong label?
options: Hides the label in the basket.
Shows the lemon picture on his card.
questions.explanation: B正确：礼貌出示柠檬订单；C未骑走；A不藏标签。

questions.prompt: How does Ravi move through the busy market?
options: He leaves the cake at the first stall.
questions.explanation: C正确：推车通过；A明确不骑人群；B已换对盒带走。

units.title: 初一阅读：温室门上的双面牌

materials.title: Greenhouse Door Check
materials.text:
Our gardening class uses a small greenhouse behind the school. In the morning, the teacher opens the door and turns its sign to “Class inside”. When everyone leaves, the last helper checks the room and turns the sign to “Empty”.

On Thursday, Hana is the last helper. She sees “Class inside” on the door, but she does not turn it immediately. First, she walks along the path between the plant tables. She finds a blue watering can under one table and puts it beside the tap.

Then she notices a classmate's notebook on a chair. She takes it to the teacher, who is waiting outside. The teacher asks whether anyone is still in the greenhouse. Hana says that she has checked both the tables and the small work corner. No one is inside.

Hana closes the door gently and turns the sign. She does not lock it herself. The teacher has the key and will lock up after checking the outside water tap.

questions.prompt: What does the sign say while the class is inside?
questions.explanation: A正确：晨入温室Class inside；B离开后；C不写无植物。

questions.prompt: What does Hana find under a plant table?
questions.explanation: C正确：蓝浇水壶；B钥匙老师拿；A笔记本椅上且未说红。

questions.prompt: Who receives the forgotten notebook?
questions.explanation: A正确：交门外老师；C访客、B兄弟未出现。

questions.prompt: Why can Hana say the greenhouse is empty?
options: She checks the tables and the work corner.
She only reads the old sign.
questions.explanation: A正确：查两个区域无人；C非单凭旧牌；B水声不证无人。

questions.prompt: Who will lock the door?
options: The classmate who lost the notebook.
questions.explanation: B正确：老师有钥匙最后锁；C明确不自锁；A失主无任务。

units.title: 初一阅读：捐赠包裹上的完成章

materials.title: Parcel Ready Stamp
materials.text:
Our class is packing book parcels for a reading club in another town. Each parcel needs two storybooks, one picture book and a message card. The teacher puts a list on every table so helpers can check the contents.

There are three steps. First, students choose the books. Next, another pair checks the parcel against the list. Only then does the teacher close the box and put a blue “Ready” stamp on it. A box without the stamp must stay on the table.

Nia finds a closed box near the door. It has no blue stamp. She does not put it on the delivery trolley. She takes it to the teacher. Inside, there are three books but no message card. Nia writes a short message, and another student checks it with her. The teacher adds the stamp after closing the box again.

The delivery driver comes at three. Students help move only the stamped boxes to the trolley. The rest will be checked tomorrow, when there is enough time to finish them carefully.

questions.prompt: What does every parcel need besides three books?
questions.explanation: A正确：两故事一图画外加留言卡；B车票、C玩具非清单。

questions.prompt: Who checks a parcel after the books are chosen?
questions.explanation: B正确：另一对核清单；C司机三点才来；A收件社团成员未在场。

questions.prompt: Why does Nia keep the closed box off the trolley?
options: It has too many picture books.
It is too heavy for any driver.
questions.explanation: B正确：无章须待检查；C未说重量；A实际缺卡非图画太多。

questions.prompt: What is missing from that box?
questions.explanation: B正确：三书都有无卡；A书已在；C盒已关有盖。

questions.prompt: When will the remaining unstamped boxes be checked?
questions.explanation: B正确：剩余明日核；C午夜、A送到后不合。

units.title: 初一阅读：下雪天的社团改场地

materials.title: Snow Day Club Room
materials.text:
The school photography club usually meets outside the front steps on Wednesday. Today, snow makes the steps slippery, so the club will meet in Room 12. There is a notice on the classroom board, but the club teacher also asks Alex to wait inside the front door for ten minutes and tell late members.

The lesson will still begin at four. Students do not need to bring outdoor shoes today because they will practise photographing small objects on a table. The teacher has brought cups, toy houses and a blue lamp. Everyone should bring their own camera or phone if they have one.

Bea has no camera. The teacher lends her the club's old one and shows her how to use it. Bea must return it before going home, but she can keep copies of her pictures.

At the end, students put the objects back in their boxes. The teacher switches off the blue lamp. Alex checks the front-door notice and changes it to say that the club has finished for the day.

questions.prompt: Why is the club indoors today?
options: The steps are slippery with snow.
questions.explanation: C正确：雪使台阶滑；A有可用相机；B今日仍上课。

questions.prompt: Where will the members meet?
questions.explanation: A正确：改12室；B常规地点今不用；C非私宅。

questions.prompt: What will students photograph?
questions.explanation: B正确：桌上小物；C不滑雪；A门非唯一拍摄物。

questions.prompt: What must Bea return before leaving?
questions.explanation: B正确：借相机返还；C照片副本可保留；A没有自带手机借还。

questions.prompt: What does Alex do at the end?
options: Keeps the blue lamp on all night.
Takes all the toy houses home.
questions.explanation: C正确：改门口告示已结束；A老师关灯；B物件归盒。

units.title: 初一阅读：有折痕的返程车票

materials.title: Tram Return Ticket
materials.text:
Lena and her grandad take a tram to the town museum. Grandad buys two return tickets and gives Lena hers. “Keep this for the journey home,” he says. Lena puts it in the small pocket of her coat.

After visiting the museum, they stop at a café. Lena takes off her coat and hangs it on her chair. When they are ready to leave, she sees a paper ticket under the table. It is for a bus, not a tram. She gives it to the café worker instead of putting it in her pocket.

At the tram stop, Grandad asks Lena for her ticket. She cannot find it in her bag because it is still in her coat pocket. Grandad asks her to think about where she put it in the morning. She remembers and finds it, a little folded but easy to read.

They get on the tram together. At home, Lena puts the used ticket in her trip notebook, next to the museum leaflet. The bus ticket stays at the café in case its owner returns.

questions.prompt: Why should Lena keep her tram ticket?
options: To give it to the museum guide.
To pay for a café meal.
To use on the return journey.
questions.explanation: C正确：返程用；B餐钱、A导游未要票。

questions.prompt: What kind of ticket is under the café table?
questions.explanation: B正确：bus非tram；C博物馆、A火车均非。

questions.prompt: Where is Lena’s own ticket?
questions.explanation: A正确：一直外套小袋；C工作者拿捡的公交票；B无据。

questions.prompt: What helps Lena find it?
options: Remembering where she put it that morning.
questions.explanation: A正确：Grandad让想早上放哪；B传单、C菜单无关。

questions.prompt: What does Lena do with the used tram ticket at home?
options: Puts it in her trip notebook.
Sends it back to the café.
questions.explanation: A正确：用过车票入游记本；C未扔传单；B公交票才留咖啡馆。

units.title: 初一阅读：袜子玩偶的材料篮

materials.title: Odd Sock Puppets
materials.text:
Our art teacher asks us to bring clean old socks for a puppet lesson. The socks do not need to be in pairs, but they must have no large holes. The teacher will provide paper eyes, coloured wool and glue.

Jules brings a bag of socks from home. One green sock has a hole at the toe. He asks whether he can use it. The teacher says it can become a small hat for another puppet, but not the puppet's main body. Jules puts it in the basket marked “Small pieces”.

He chooses a long grey sock for his puppet and adds wool for hair. He wants to use two tiny buttons for eyes. The teacher asks him to use the larger paper eyes instead, because they are the materials prepared for this class. Jules keeps the buttons in his bag.

After the lesson, each puppet stands on a cardboard tube to dry. Students write their names on the tubes. They may take the puppets home tomorrow, after the glue is dry.

questions.prompt: Which socks are suitable for the puppet’s main body?
options: Any dirty sock with a big hole.
questions.explanation: B正确：干净无大洞；A不需成对也不需新；C违条件。

questions.prompt: What can the green sock become?
questions.explanation: C正确：大洞绿袜可小帽；A幕布、B封面非建议。

questions.prompt: Which sock does Jules use for the body?
options: The green one with a hole.
questions.explanation: A正确：选长灰袜；C去小料篮；B未出现。

questions.prompt: What does Jules use for the puppet’s eyes in class?
options: The tiny buttons from his bag.
questions.explanation: C正确：按老师用大纸眼；A纽扣留包；B绿袜小帽非眼。

questions.prompt: When can students take the puppets home?
options: While the glue is still wet today.
Tomorrow, when the glue is dry.
questions.explanation: C正确：次日干后；B湿胶不带；A名写筒供识别。

units.title: 初一阅读：纸盒城镇的展示台

materials.title: Reused Box Display
materials.text:
Class Seven is building a model town from used cardboard boxes. Before cutting a box, students remove old food and check that it is clean. Boxes with wet or oily marks go into a different pile and are not used for the model.

Marta makes a tall library from a cereal box. Her friend Eli wants to put it in the middle of the model. Marta asks him to leave space for a road first. They place the library near the edge so visitors can see both the front door and the road leading to it.

The teacher asks each group to add a label explaining one idea in its town. Marta's group writes, “People can walk from the homes to the library without crossing the car park.” They draw a dotted walking path beside the houses.

On display day, the models stand on low tables. Students must carry their towns with both hands under the base. Eli opens the classroom door for Marta while she carries their model to its table.

questions.prompt: Which boxes are not used?
options: Boxes with wet or oily marks.
Boxes with writing on the outside.
questions.explanation: A正确：湿油印盒不用；C干净可用；B外字未禁止。

questions.prompt: Why do Marta and Eli leave space before placing the library?
questions.explanation: C正确：先留道路；A藏房、B池无此计划。

questions.prompt: Where is the library placed?
options: Near the edge of the model.
questions.explanation: C正确：模型边缘可见门路；B桌下、A真实图书馆非位置。

questions.prompt: What does the dotted line show?
options: A wall around the car park.
A place to cut the model in half.
questions.explanation: C正确：点线步道；A墙、B切线无据。

questions.prompt: How does Eli help when Marta carries the model?
options: He pulls it by its roof.
He walks away with the base.
questions.explanation: C正确：开门；A拉屋顶、B拿走底座均非帮法。

units.title: 初一阅读：运动日里的彩带分工

materials.title: Sports Ribbon Roles
materials.text:
For sports day, our class has two jobs before the first race. The green team puts numbered flags beside the running lanes. The orange team takes water cups to the rest table. Everyone must finish before the runners arrive at ten.

Pia belongs to the green team. She finds flag 6 in a bag of orange ribbons. Instead of leaving it there, she takes it to her team leader. They check the lane numbers and place the flag beside lane 6. The ribbons stay in their bag until the afternoon parade.

At nine fifty, a teacher asks whether the rest table is ready. There are water bottles on it but no cups. Pia does not move the numbered flags again. She tells the orange team, and two members bring the missing cups from the hall.

When the first runners arrive, both jobs are finished. Pia stands behind the marked waiting line to watch. She will not cross a running lane to collect the flags until a teacher says the race is over.

questions.prompt: What is the green team’s first job?
questions.explanation: A正确：绿队放赛道旗；C橙队水杯；B游行下午。

questions.prompt: Where does Pia find flag 6?
options: In a bag of orange ribbons.
questions.explanation: A正确：橙彩带袋找到6号旗；B桌下、C琴旁无据。

questions.prompt: What is missing from the rest table at nine fifty?
questions.explanation: A正确：有水瓶无杯；B瓶已在；C旗不该在休息桌。

questions.prompt: Who brings the missing cups?
options: The first runners during the race.
questions.explanation: A正确：橙队两人厅取杯；C运动员未取；B绿队不负责杯。

questions.prompt: When may Pia cross a lane to collect flags?
options: As soon as the first runner appears.
Whenever she sees an empty cup.
After a teacher says the race is over.
questions.explanation: C正确：老师宣布结束后；A开跑即跨不合；B杯与通行时机无关。

units.title: 初一阅读：旧相册下面的一行字

materials.title: Album Caption Call
materials.text:
Noah is making a small family photo display for his grandmother's birthday. He chooses a picture of her beside an old bus. The date on the back says 1987, but Noah does not know where the bus is going.

He first asks his dad. Dad remembers the bus but says he was too young to remember the trip clearly. He suggests calling Aunt Rosa, who was there. Noah phones her after dinner and describes the picture.

Aunt Rosa says the family was visiting a lake, not travelling to the seaside as Noah had guessed. She also remembers that the bus broke down for an hour, so everyone ate lunch beside a field. Noah writes those details on a separate sheet before making the caption.

The display will include the photo, the year and one short sentence about the lake trip. Noah does not write directly on the old photograph. He puts the caption below it and keeps his longer notes in an envelope with Aunt Rosa's name on the front.

questions.prompt: What date is on the photograph?
questions.explanation: B正确：背面1987；A换位1978、C1997不符。

questions.prompt: Why does Dad suggest calling Aunt Rosa?
options: She was on the trip and may remember it.
She owns every bus in town.
questions.explanation: B正确：Rosa在场，Dad当时幼小记不清；A手机未丢；C非车主。

questions.prompt: Where was the family going?
questions.explanation: A正确：湖，非Noah猜海边；C猜测已更正；B学校无据。

questions.prompt: What happened to the bus?
options: It broke down for an hour.
questions.explanation: C正确：故障一小时；B咖啡馆、A一年迟到无据。

questions.prompt: Where does Noah put the short caption?
options: Across his grandmother’s face in the photo.
questions.explanation: B正确：照片下方题注，不直接写旧照；A涂脸、C只手机非展板。

units.title: 初二阅读：营地两条路的实走检查

materials.title: Camp Path Check
materials.text:
Our class was asked to make a visitor guide for a small campsite. The owner gave us a map showing two routes from the gate to the activity field. The short path passed a shop, while the longer one went around a pond. At first, we wanted to recommend the short route to everyone.

Before writing the guide, we walked both routes with a staff member. The short path included three steps near the shop. Those steps did not appear on the simple map. The longer path had no steps, but a gate beside the pond was kept closed when animals were in the next field. Visitors could open it with staff help; they were asked not to leave it open behind them.

Our first sentence had said, “The short route is the easiest.” After the walk, we changed it. We described the distance, the steps and the gate separately, so visitors could decide which information mattered to them. We also added where they could ask for help.

The owner checked the guide before it was printed. She pointed out that the shop shut early on Wednesdays, so it should not be described as the only place to get directions. The reception desk remained open later.

The final guide did not choose one route for every visitor. It made the differences clearer. Walking the paths and checking the opening hours had given us useful details that a quick look at the map could not provide.

questions.prompt: What did the class initially want to recommend?
options: The route used by the animals.
No route from the gate at all.
Only a boat across the pond.
questions.explanation: B正确：初想统一荐短路；D未设船；A非动物路线；C任务正写访客路线。

questions.prompt: What was missing from the simple map?
options: The pond beside the longer route.
questions.explanation: D正确：地图未画三阶；B门、A活动场、C池均路线已有。

questions.prompt: What should visitors avoid doing at the pond gate?
options: Walking on a route without steps.
questions.explanation: A正确：过后不敞门；B可寻帮助；D应读指南；C长路无阶可用。

questions.prompt: Why was the shop not described as the only place for directions?
options: It had no connection with the campsite.
questions.explanation: C正确：周三早关，接待处开更晚；B营地路线有关；D未无人访；A非通宵。

questions.prompt: What did the final guide do?
options: Removed every opening time from the information.
Explained route differences so visitors could judge their needs.
Ignored what the staff member had shown the class.
Claimed the shortest route was always easiest for everyone.
questions.explanation: B正确：分述距离阶门供需求选择；D撤回一刀切；A核开放时间并给帮助；C步测和工作人员信息正是基础。
